config_name: Gigabyte AERO X16 — Ryzen AI 7 350 / RTX 5060, 16GB/1TB ($2,099) or 32GB/1TB ($2,499) RAM tiers

specs.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 7 350 (8-core: 4 Zen 5 + 4 Zen 5c, Krackan Point, 50-TOPS NPU)
specs.ports: 1x USB4 40Gbps (PD), 2x USB-A 3.0, 1x USB 2.0, HDMI, gigabit Ethernet, 3.5mm

battery.notes: 76Wh + efficient Zen 5 + lower-TGP 5060; ~7.5-8h light use est.

price.notes: BBY API-verified 2026-11-24. Two BBY-direct 5060 tiers consolidated: SKU 19801006 (16GB/1TB, reg $2,999 / sale $2,099) and SKU 19801007 (32GB/1TB, reg $3,569 / sale $2,499).

reviews.quote: Together with the AMD processor, this results in an efficient package and many games can also be played smoothly in QHD resolution.

praises: Cheapest entry into the NBC-reviewed 84% creator chassis: Copilot+ Zen 5 + RTX 5060 at $2,099 sale
RAM upgradeable to 64GB and two M.2 slots even on the base tier (NBC pro)
Efficient platform gives the best battery life of the Gigabyte lineup
Matte flicker-free 165Hz WQXGA IPS, fine for sRGB editing (NBC)
USB4 + MUX switch at a budget creator price
complaints: 16GB base RAM is tight for creator workloads (though upgradeable)
RTX 5060 is the weak Blackwell part for a creator-marketed machine
Weak 1080p webcam, no Wi-Fi 7, USB 2.0 port (NBC cons)
Retailer SKU ambiguity: same SKU family listed with both 5060 and 5070 GPU tiers — verify config before buying

design_philosophy: The entry tiers of the creator-styled AERO X16: the same slim 19.9mm Zen 5 chassis NBC reviewed at 84%, paired with the lower RTX 5060 GPU to hit sub-$2,100 creator pricing. The serviceable interior (RAM to 64GB, dual M.2) means the base tier can grow with the user — the philosophy is upgrade-over-upfront.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from NBC's Aero X16 1WH review (84%, RTX 5070/32GB): RTX 5060 vs 5070 -> gaming -1.5, creative_work -1.0; 16GB base RAM -> productivity -1.0, ai_ml -0.5 (the 32GB twin at $2,499 restores those to anchor values); lower GPU load -> battery +0.5, thermals +0.5. Consolidated entry per schema rule 1 (RAM variants listed in config_name).
standouts: Cheapest AERO X16: the 84%-rated creator platform at $2,099 sale
Fully upgradeable RAM/storage even at the entry tier
dealbreakers: 16GB RAM and RTX 5060 undercut the creator pitch out of the box
